title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
company: Tech-long Packaging Machinery India Pvt Ltd
description:
**ABOUT THE COMPANY**

Tech Long Packaging Machinery India Pvt. Ltd. is part of the Tech Long Group, a global leader in PET bottle blowing, filling, and packaging machinery solutions serving the beverage, food, and FMCG industries.

**ROLE SUMMARY**

We are looking for a proactive and results-driven Talent Acquisition professional to manage end-to-end recruitment for engineering, manufacturing, sales, and corporate functions. The ideal candidate will have strong sourcing skills, an understanding of the manufacturing/machinery industry, and the ability to build a strong talent pipeline to support business growth.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Manage the complete recruitment lifecycle — sourcing, screening, interviewing, offer negotiation, and onboarding.
* Partner with department heads (Engineering, Production, Sales, Service) to understand manpower requirements and define job specifications.
* Source candidates through job portals (Naukri, LinkedIn), employee referrals, campus drives, and consultants.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline for technical roles (mechanical/electrical/mechatronics engineers, service engineers) as well as sales and support functions.
* Coordinate interview scheduling and manage communication with candidates and hiring managers.
* Negotiate compensation offers in line with company salary bands and market benchmarks.
* Track recruitment metrics (TAT, cost-per-hire, source effectiveness) and report to management.
* Manage vendor/consultant relationships and manpower agency coordination.
* Ensure a smooth onboarding experience and coordinate joining formalities with HR operations.
* Support employer branding initiatives, campus engagement, and job fairs.
* Maintain recruitment MIS, trackers, and compliance with company hiring policies.

**REQUIRED SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's/Master's degree in HR, Business Administration, or a related field (MBA/PGDM in HR preferred).
* 2-6 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, preferably in manufacturing, engineering, or capital goods/machinery industry.
* Strong knowledge of sourcing tools, ATS, and job portals.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to handle bulk and niche technical hiring.
* Proficiency in MS Office/Excel; ATS or HRMS tool experience is a plus.
* Understanding of Indian labor laws and compliance basics is an advantage.

**PREFERRED ATTRIBUTES**

* Prior experience hiring for machinery/packaging/automation/capital equipment companies.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.
* Strong stakeholder management skills with cross-functional teams.

**COMPENSATION**

As per industry standards, commensurate with experience.

Pay: ₹30,000.00 - ₹35,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule
* Health insurance
* Life insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Talent Acquisition Lead
description:
**About the role**  

TechBlocks is looking for a Lead Talent Acquisition Specialist to drive technical hiring across our India teams. You will own the recruitment process from intake to offer, build talent pipelines for hard\-to\-fill roles, and partner with hiring managers and Talent Acquisition leaders to make well\-informed hiring decisions.  

This role suits a hands\-on recruiter who enjoys sourcing, understands technology roles, and can guide hiring teams through a clear, responsive process. **What you’ll do*** **Lead Full\-Cycle Recruitment:** Manage the end\-to\-end recruitment process, including sourcing, interviewing, and onboarding technical candidates across various roles.
* **Sourcing Candidates:** Utilize various sourcing techniques, including job boards, social media, networking, and employee referrals to identify potential candidates.
* **Collaboration:** Partner with hiring managers to understand job requirements, develop effective recruitment strategies, and set clear expectations for the hiring process.
* **Screening and Interviewing:** Conduct thorough screenings and interviews to assess candidates technical skills, experience, and cultural fit.
* **Candidate Engagement:** Maintain ongoing communication with candidates throughout the recruitment process to ensure a positive candidate experience.
* **Market Research:** Stay updated on industry trends, salary benchmarks, and talent acquisition best practices to attract top talent.
* **Data Management:** Maintain accurate and up\-to\-date records of all recruitment activities in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* **Reporting:** Provide regular reports on recruitment metrics, including time\-to\-fill, candidate pipeline status, and sourcing effectiveness.

 **What you bring*** 10\+ years of experience in technical recruitment, including ownership of complex or hard\-to\-fill roles.
* A strong understanding of software development, cloud, data, AI, and related technology positions.
* Proven ability to source passive candidates and build relationships with technical talent.
* Experience partnering with hiring managers and managing multiple searches in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong interviewing, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Confidence using an ATS, job boards, and sourcing tools to manage an accurate pipeline.
* A bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

 **Why TechBlocks*** Work directly with Fortune 500 executives and digital transformation leaders.
* Be part of a fast\-growing, AI\-native software engineering firm redefining global delivery through our GCC\-as\-a\-Service model.
* Collaborate with global teams in Canada, the U.S., and India on cutting\-edge cloud and AI initiatives.
* Competitive compensation, performance incentives, and a culture that values ownership, agility, and innovation.

title: Talent Acquisition Executive
description:
**JUNIOR TALENT ACQUISITION EXECUTIVE**

**Experience:** 1\-2 years in a Pure IT Service Company

**POSITION OVERVIEW**  
We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Junior Talent Acquisition Executive to join our HR team. The ideal candidate will have 1\-2 years of proven expertise in recruiting for IT Service companies. This role involves end\-to\-end recruitment processes to identify, attract, and onboard top talent that aligns with our organizational goals.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

*Talent Sourcing \& Screening*

* Source candidates through various channels, including job boards, social media, referrals, and networking.
* Screen resumes and conduct initial phone interviews to assess candidate fit.

*Recruitment Process Management*

* Manage end\-to\-end recruitment processes, including posting job openings, coordinating interviews, and facilitating offer negotiations.
* Scheduling minimum 5 interviews per day.
* Ensure a smooth and positive candidate experience throughout the recruitment cycle.

*Stakeholder Collaboration*

* Work closely with hiring managers to understand job requirements and team expectations.
* Provide timely updates on recruitment progress and offer insights into talent market trends.

*Database \& Reporting*

* Maintain and update candidate databases in the Applicant Tracking System (ATS).
* Prepare recruitment reports and analytics to track hiring progress and performance metrics.

*Employer Branding*

* Actively promote the company's brand to attract and engage potential candidates.
* Participate in career fairs and other recruitment events.

**Additional Responsibilities**

* Conduct background verification for new joiners to ensure compliance and authenticity.
* Collaborate with the system admin, HR administration team, and hiring managers to streamline the onboarding process and associated activities.
* Plan and execute recruitment walk\-in drives for bulk hiring to meet organizational needs.
* Organize townhall sessions, office tours, and engaging onboarding activities to create a positive experience for new employees.
* Coordinate with HR Team for any events happening in the organization.

**Qualifications \& Requirements:**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
* 1\-2 years of experience in talent acquisition, specifically in IT Service companies (not Product/SaaS/Consultancy).
* Strong understanding of IT roles and skill sets.
* Proficiency in recruitment tools, ATS, and platforms like LinkedIn, Naukri, etc.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to multitask and meet tight deadlines in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strong problem\-solving skills and a proactive approach to challenges.

**HR Operations Activity**

* Support HR in onboarding, offboarding, and employee documentation.
* Maintain employee records, ID cards, access cards, and asset allocation details.
* Assist in employee life\-cycle activities and HR operational tasks.
* Participate in Event Management.

**Job Type:** Full\-time

Pay: ₹10,325\.84 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Leave encashment
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Deputy General Manager - Talent Acquisition
description:
### **Responsibilities**


**1\. Strategic Talent Acquisition**


* Partner with business leaders and HRBPs to understand workforce needs and develop proactive hiring strategies.
* Lead full\-cycle recruitment for mid to senior\-level roles, ensuring quality and timely hiring.
* Analyze talent market trends and provide insights to improve sourcing strategies.
* Drive employer branding initiatives to enhance the company’s visibility and attractiveness in the talent market.


**2\. Recruitment Operations \& Process Excellence**


* Oversee job postings, sourcing, screening, interviewing, and offer management.
* Manage relationships with recruitment agencies, job portals, and other sourcing partners.
* Implement and optimize ATS and recruitment tools for efficiency and data accuracy.
* Track and report recruitment metrics (TAT, cost\-per\-hire, source effectiveness, etc.) to leadership.


**3\. Onboarding \& Candidate Experience**


* Design and execute structured onboarding programs in collaboration with HR, Admin, IT, and Security.
* Ensure seamless Day\-1 readiness including documentation, system access, and induction.
* Continuously improve onboarding experience based on feedback and best practices.


**4\. Compliance \& Documentation**


* Ensure adherence to internal policies and external regulations in all hiring practices.
* Maintain accurate and audit\-ready documentation for all recruitment and onboarding activities.
* Support internal and external audits related to hiring processes.


**5\. Team Leadership \& Stakeholder Engagement**


* Mentor and guide junior recruiters and support staff.
* Act as a point of contact for business leaders on all talent acquisition matters.
* Collaborate cross\-functionally with HR, Admin, IT, and Finance for smooth hiring and onboarding.

### **Qualifications**


**Qualifications \& Experience**


* **Education:** Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field.
* **Experience:** 15\-20 years of progressive experience in talent acquisition, preferably in a mid\-to\-large scale organization.
* **Preferred Exposure:** Experience in managing bulk hiring, niche roles, and leadership hiring.


**Skills \& Competencies**


* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Expertise in sourcing strategies, interview techniques, and recruitment analytics.
* Proficiency in ATS, HRIS systems, and MS Office Suite.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment.
* Strategic thinking with a hands\-on execution mindset.
